How can I create AI product photos from a reference image with tested prompts and visible inputs and outputs? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
Creating high-quality AI product photography from a reference image requires a structured image-to-image (Img2Img) workflow. Instead of asking the AI to invent a product from scratch, you provide a clean, real photo of your product (the input reference) and use bounded prompts to control the environment (the output) while locking down the product’s identity. 
nightjar.so
 +1
Step 1: Prepare Your Input Reference Image
The quality of your output is strictly capped by your input. To prevent the AI from altering your product’s shape, logos, or textures, prepare your reference image using the following criteria: 
www.gotolstoy.com
 +2
Isolate the Product: Use a white or neutral gray background. If your source photo has background clutter, use an object isolation tool first. 
Figma
 +1
Neutral, Diffuse Lighting: Avoid harsh shadows or strong color casts, as the AI will carry those baked-in shadows into the new generated scene. 
Nim · The ultimate app for AI video production
 +1
High Resolution: Use at least a 1080p (ideally 4K or 2048x2048px) uncompressed image so text, fine labels, and stitching remain completely sharp. 
Nim · The ultimate app for AI video production
Step 2: Configure Your Settings
When uploading your reference to a compatible workflow canvas or generator (such as Figma Weave or OpenArt), you must adjust the structural inputs: 
OpenArt
 +1
Choose the Right Model: Use photorealistic engines like Nano Banana Pro or FLUX.1 for true-to-life studio assets.
Set the Image Strength / Creativity Slider: Set this to a lower value (near the reference side). A lower creativity setting forces the model to stay strictly anchored to the product shape while only reinterpreting the background. 
OpenArt
Step 3: Write Bounded Creative Prompts
Do not write abstract prompts. Effective product photography prompts must blend commercial art direction with strict product exclusions. 
PrompTessor
The Tested Prompt Template Structure: 
www.gotolstoy.com
 +1
[Product/SKU Description] resting on [Surface/Platform], surrounded by [Background Environment/Props]. [Lighting Type and Direction]. [Camera Angle and Shot Type]. Keep the [Product Details, Logos, Colors, Text] exactly as shown in the reference image, completely untouched, sharp focus.
3 Tested Prompt Examples
Tested Prompt 1: Studio Clean Hero Shot (Best for Ecommerce Listings)
Input Reference: A high-res photo of a skincare bottle on a white background.
Prompt: A professional studio product photograph of a clear glass skincare bottle. The bottle is resting centered on a smooth, beige concrete pedestal. Clean, minimalist background with soft, ambient, diffuse studio lighting from the top-left. Crisp reflections, subtle shadows. Sharp focus on the product. Keep the front label text, cap color, and branding exactly as shown in the reference image, completely untouched.
Expected Output: A highly professional, platform-ready hero image with readable text and clean edges. 
Designkit
 +1
Tested Prompt 2: Lifestyle Scene (Best for Social Media/Ads)
Input Reference: A clean photo of an olive-green canvas backpack.
Prompt: A lifestyle product shot of an olive-green canvas backpack. The backpack is resting upright on a pale stone bench in an outdoor garden. Soft, natural morning daylight filtering through overhead leaves, creating gentle dappled light. Warm, organic atmosphere. Cinematic depth of field with a softly blurred background. Keep the front label, two handles, zipper closures, and rectangular shape consistent with the reference image.
Expected Output: The product seamlessly blended into a realistic, high-end lifestyle context. 
LTX
 +1
Tested Prompt 3: Luxury & Botanical (Best for Hero Banners)
Input Reference: A cosmetic or perfume bottle.
Prompt: Commercial advertising photography of a cosmetic bottle. The bottle is elegantly placed on a wet dark slate surface, surrounded by minimalist green botanical monstera leaves. Dramatic side lighting highlighting the product texture. Water droplets misting on the slate. Luxury aesthetic, high contrast. The product silhouette, label layout, and color palette must remain strictly identical to the reference photo.
Expected Output: An eye-catching, creative ad asset tailored for premium branding. 
Figma
 +2
Step 4: Review Your Inputs & Outputs (QA)
AI can still distort text or invent small details. Use a side-by-side workflow to quality-assure your outputs against the original reference before publishing: 
nightjar.so
 +1
Check Fine Text: Skincare or tech products often carry tiny ingredient or capacity lists. Verify they remain completely legible.
Look for Artifacts: Ensure the product edges are sharp and haven't melted into the new background.
Refine and Save: If the AI alters a feature, tighten your prompt constraints (e.g., adding "do not change the cap color"), regenerate, and save the successful prompt as a repeatable "recipe" for future product variations. 
nightjar.so
 +3
To help tailor a prompt for you, tell me:
What type of product are you trying to shoot?
What kind of background scene or aesthetic do you want to create?
What specific text or brand marks on the product must stay perfectly intact?
